blocks.text: Filinvest Land, Inc. (FLI) achieved a significant industry milestone at the Philippines Real Estate Awards 2026, earning the distinction of Best Developer in Metro Manila, Best Developer in the Visayas, and Best Developer in Mindanao. The Visayas win marks FLI’s second consecutive year receiving the distinction, while its Mindanao recognition extends its winning streak to three consecutive years. These recognitions reflect Filinvest Land’s commitment to creating communities that respond to the distinct needs and aspirations of Filipino families across the country.
